title: One event as accepted by POST /events
description: The runtimeevents Event envelope plus the two things the hub requires of a publisher: a canonical producer-minted id (evt_ and 32 lowercase hex, contract decision 6) and an app (the credential's app binding needs one). Everything else is the generic envelope, which tolerates unknown vocabulary values; no enums are added here. The payload is only required to be JSON; per-kind payload schemas are not validated at ingest.
